definitions.gloss: supporting role, supporting actor, secondary part
definitions.explanation: A secondary or supporting role in a play, film, or other performance, as opposed to the lead. Also used figuratively for someone who plays a secondary or supporting part in any situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脇役|わきやく}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{存在感|そんざいかん}→存在感：19948_sonzaikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Despite being in a supporting role, he has a strong presence.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脇役|わきやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: The supporting actors' performances shine in this film.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脇役|わきやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脇役|わきやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The supporting actor's job is to make the lead shine, but sometimes the supporting cast drives the story.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used figuratively outside of entertainment — for example, someone who plays a secondary role in a project or event. The figurative use is not necessarily negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脇役|わきやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧ (play a supporting role)
- {脇役|わきやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{徹|てっ}する→徹する：12567_tessuru⟧ (commit fully to a supporting role)
- {脇役|わきやく}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (though in a supporting role)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧: lead role, protagonist (opposite of {脇役|わきやく})
- ⟦{端役|はやく}→端役：24247_hayaku⟧: bit part, minor role (even smaller than {脇役|わきやく})
- ⟦{助演|じょえん}→助演：18098_joen⟧: supporting performance (used in award categories like ⟦{助演|じょえん}{男優|だんゆう}→助演男優：23856_joendanyuu⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧)
